- no_additive_realification (v) : there is no L : Completion (QPlace v) →+ ℝ with L x = realBridge v x for all x in actualLogShell_v. Proof with the uniformizer pi: the shell is an AddSubgroup containing pi, pi+pi, (pi+pi)+(pi+pi); additivity forces log‖2‖ = log‖pi‖ and log‖2‖ = log‖2pi‖ = log‖2‖+log‖pi‖, so log‖pi‖=0, contradicting ‖pi‖<1.
- LevelwiseRealificationFunctional v (additive + agrees on shell + image = reduced shell) is provably empty: levelwiseRealificationFunctional_not_nonempty.

Hence no function at all does it (no_levelwise_realification_function).
- What DOES exist (constructed): additiveNormLog : Additive ((Completion (QPlace v))ˣ) →+ ℝ, u ↦ log‖u‖, plus the levelwise SET identities paperPreLogShell v = range(additiveNormLog) and paperLogShell v = p*^{-1} * range(additiveNormLog).
- Why the actual datum cannot be realified levelwise: completionUnits_norm_eq_one (integral units have norm 1) ⇒ realBridge_image_completionUnits : realBridge '' (O_vˣ) = {0}; and additive_functional_trivial_on_preLogShell: any additive L agreeing with the norm-log readout on integral units vanishes on the whole pre-log-shell.
- Sharp statement unchanged: s1977_span_bridge_sharp = S1961 bridgeFiber_eq_paperSpan.
EXACT FIRST MISSING (replacement): not a functional, but an identification O_vˣ ~ K_vˣ compatible with the norm-log readout (uniformizer splitting); impossible because the left readout is identically zero. So the local p-adic/real bridge is Q-span/volume level only.
